author: Mike Kasberg

mapping.sheet: Adopted 1.6 mm default sheet; 1.6–2 mm range. Plinth 2–2.6 mm is redesigned.
mapping.socket: Measured 4.5 mm receiving-slot width is the adopted interface scale; 4.5 mm male tongues are a proposed nominal reconstruction, not a measured source male dimension. Receiving slots=(4.5+TOTAL fit)×(sheet+TOTAL fit); .15 mm default gives4.65×1.75 mm.
mapping.runners: Measured .21/.22 mm low planes inspire thicker proposed .4–.6 mm breakaway runners, .8–1.4 mm wide. Twelve tabs join three parts to one carrier.
mapping.assembly: Original cantilever mast with TWO vertically inserted tongues; shallow needle saddle on separately thread-suspended cradle. Tongue depth=plinth thickness−.2; shoulders contact plinth. Fixed seats require adhesive.
mapping.clearance: 24 kernel yaw tests plus continuous conservative radial bound reach−3−hypot(cradleLength/2,5)>10 mm for all supported combinations; cradle underside at least14 mm above deck; overhead gap>=22 mm. Swing and tilt untested.
mapping.suspension: External equal thread legs from two cradle eyes to one loop through mast eye. Estimated leader knot6 mm below eye centre (2 mm below arm), routed down front face; horizontal cradle centred below. Yaw/drop only change assembly positioning and external thread schedule, not exported plastic. Thread torsion, magnetism and dynamics not simulated.
mapping.imports: Boolean engraved protected front plinth zone radius6.5 mm, .4–.6 mm deep; minimum1.4 mm backing. Source mesh never hull-replaced.

notAReskin: Not the prior two-rib reflector, panpipe rack, bifilar yarn spindle or equal-arm balance. No optical parabola, straw apertures or load pans. Original cantilever, three thread eyes, recessed needle saddle, single-apex yaw suspension and magnetic-needle external assembly. Reuses tested local studio/import/export infrastructure only.
